correctness.rationale: A fixed first-order sentence exactly defines the finite validating frames by Takahashi's finite-reduction lemma. Direct syntactic unrolling on labeled adjacency matrices gives constant depth and polynomial size because quantifier rank and variable width are constants. The contrapositive and parity-hardness corollary follow by closure of AC^0 under composition and the unconditional parity lower bound.
